items.title: Mat Domber interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: Milt Fillius hipped me to it

ctx.x: Okay. Because it was so odd. When we started doing these interviewing sessions I had not been aware of this jazz party phenomenon. And Milt Fillius hipped me to it, and he © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-

said, “Here’s a good way to get some of these interviews is you go and you be there for the three days. And I was amazed that such a thing existed. I sort of didn’t know about it. But I also was amazed at how hip the audience was that came to these things. I just — you don’t expect people to be so informed about the music.
